snippet.title: Inkression - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Enter the world of Milly, a troubled tattoo artist who sets out to revive her dying neighborhood by collecting remaining stories through her art. Walk the streets of Nortown, witness the comes and goes of its people, and redefine the meaning behind each tattoo. Watch the Inkression trailer for this upcoming first-person narrative game to see what to expect. Inkression will be available on PC in 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.
